svg.title: Gradient descent in a curved optimization valley
svg.desc: Contours of f(x,y)=(1−x)²+30(y−x²)². The gold path is 6000 ordinary gradient-descent steps from (−1.2,1) with step size 0.0015. The final iterate is approximately (0.988391,0.976761), approaching the marked exact minimizer (1,1). This is an illustration of optimization, not training data or a model-performance claim.
